description: Returns the current state of one analysis: status, package (price, refunds, last error, `retry_available`, `refund_on_cancel`), steps, progress, ready deliverables, `web_url`, `action_required` and `next_poll_after_seconds`. Requires sign-in (OAuth connector or API key) with the runs:read scope. Analyses run in the background: poll this tool no sooner than `next_poll_after_seconds`, until it is null. Null means the analysis reached a final state, or `action_required` is retry_or_cancel (failed work waiting for qualitative_retry_analysis or qualitative_cancel_analysis), or continue_in_web_app (waiting for the user in the web app, e.g. stale steps after inputs changed or a decision). Stop polling for continue_in_web_app, tell the user to continue in the web app and give them the run link in web_url. Do not keep polling when null. Read-only: it never starts or changes work. `deliverables_ready` lists the downloads that are ready; the first entry of type `main_report` is the main report every analysis includes (it appears as soon as the report step is done, also when no extra report was bought). Fetch it with qualitative_get_deliverable; qualitative_list_deliverables lists all outputs.

run_id.description: The analysis id (`run_id`) from qualitative_list_runs or qualitative_start_analysis.
